title: Deterministic evidence verifier for cheap-model implementation classification (HYP-0001)
summary: Paired design: 3 samples per base route (claude-sonnet-5-5 @balanced, gpt-6-luna @fast, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 @fast), each output scored with and without the deterministic EvidenceVerifier; 9 model calls (budget 18), worktree pinned to f8f4453f. Treatment effect: none (1 downgrade in 27 answers, which lowered Luna by one item). Offline replay on EVR-0005 outputs had predicted this before any spend (Luna 0.60 -> 0.55; others unchanged). HYP-0001 rejected: over-claims cite real but irrelevant code, which an existence check cannot catch. Secondary result: all routes plateau at 0.67-0.70 mean accuracy; majority voting reaches only 0.70-0.75; only 2/20 items are unanimous across 9 samples. The task definition (partial vs missing) is too ambiguous to qualify any route against, so the experiment is closed rather than extended.

metrics.design: paired within-sample; treatment = post-hoc verifier; 9 calls
metrics.success_criterion: any route mean accuracy >= 0.9 at <= 1.5x cost
metrics.luna_cost: not reported by the Codex subscription

provenance.author_tier: frontier (Opus 5.5) analysis of deterministic eval output
